title: Coastal storm
summary: Heavy rainfall coincides with a high tide and storm surge. The Harborside warehouse and the Quay pump station are threatened; teams must choose protection priorities within budget.
provenance: Synthetic design event authored for the POC. Not derived from observations.
assumptions: Rainfall, tide and surge are smooth synthetic curves.
Overtopping uses a lumped weir coefficient (0.05 m^0.5/s).
Soil starts moderately wet; no ground restrictions are expected.
known_constraints: Two barrier sets and one temporary pump are available.
Budget does not cover protecting every exposed asset.
expected_behavior: Without action the warehouse, the residences, both pump stations and the Marsh Lane substation flood near the surge peak. Within the budget, the agent-guided constrained plan protects the substation and keeps the water works powered, which roughly halves simulated disruption; Harbor Flats assets still flood. Protecting every exposed asset is not affordable.

params.notes: Harbor operator reports the quay outfall flap valves were serviced last month.
